name: Speech to Text
description:
Write with your voice, right where you need the words.

Dictate a quick reply, capture a thought, or talk through a longer prompt without switching apps. Press Super+Z or click the panel icon to start recording, speak, then press or click again to stop. Your recording is transcribed and the words are pasted into the field you're working in.

Use it in browsers, editors, chat apps, and terminals that support standard paste shortcuts. The transcript is also copied to your clipboard for manual pasting.

Choose a speech recognition model or an audio-capable AI model through OpenRouter. Let the model detect your language, or select it yourself. Customize or disable the default Super+Z shortcut, move or hide the panel icon, and choose whether recording sounds play.

To get started, add your OpenRouter API key in preferences and choose a compatible model. Internet access is required. Model availability and pricing depend on OpenRouter and the selected provider.

Recording starts only when you activate it. After you stop, audio is sent over HTTPS to OpenRouter for transcription; processing and retention depend on the provider. The extension writes transcribed text to your clipboard, does not read other clipboard contents, and collects no telemetry.
